description: Bounded 3-store corrected-method event/assessment pass for The Game Cellar, Next-Gen Games, and It's GameTime. Adds current source-supported Magic event coverage that is missing from Supabase, captures Next-Gen's official Discord route as evidence with content replay TBD, and preserves uncertainty where exact format or turnout remains unknown. This proposal does not change schema/auth/RLS/app code or canonical JSON.
author: Codex Project Steward

operations.reason: Wizards/EventLink export contains current July-September 2026 The Game Cellar Commander Party and Hobbit prerelease records.
Wizards/EventLink export contains current July-October 2026 Next-Gen Magic rows beyond the already captured Wednesday Commander series.
Wizards/EventLink export still supports It's GameTime Sunday Casual Commander rows in the checked July-August 2026 window.

Next-Gen's official site links this Discord as a community route. The route is useful for future turnout, LFG, proxy, solo-arrival, and event-reliability replay, but Discord content was not inspected in this pass.

fields.title: All Day Sunday Commander
fields.details: Wizards/EventLink lists All Day Sunday Commander at Next-Gen Games with $5 entry and 64-player capacity. The export's local scheduled time renders as 11:00 PM, which conflicts with the all-day title and store hours. This row uses Next-Gen's official Sunday opening time, 11:00 AM, as a planning proxy and records that assumption.

operations.reason: Make the clear current Sunday Commander signal visible while preserving the start-time ambiguity.

operations.reason: Make finite Commander specials visible without modeling them as weekly recurrence.

fields.title: Friday Night Magic
fields.details: It's GameTime's official site lists Friday Night Magic at 8:00 PM. The site does not specify the format, registration, entry fee, or whether this appears in Wizards/EventLink, so keep this as a medium-confidence recurring FNM/Magic signal rather than normalizing it as Commander, draft, or sealed.

operations.reason: Make a store-controlled recurring Friday Magic signal visible while preserving format uncertainty.
